subject: RDMA: Protect RDMA memory regions (#1602)
reason: The change only touches src/rdma.c, which is compiled only with BUILD_RDMA and whose changed functions (rdmaMemoryAlloc/rdmaMemoryFree, called from rdmaSetupIoBuf, rdmaAdjustSendbuf and rdmaDestroyIoBuf) execute only when an RDMA client establishes a connection. That requires RDMA hardware or soft-RoCE with root, neither of which the fuzzer's throwaway local servers have, and no installed component or experiment can open an RDMA connection — all workloads and command sequences use TCP/unix sockets.
